body:
The #652 repair mints kgmicrobe.compound identities for FeSO4 x 5 H2O, FeSO4 x 6 H2O, MgSO4 x 6 H2O, and MnSO4 x 7 H2O, but it currently leaves the external CHEBI parent row as skos:closeMatch / CLOSE_MATCH.

For a hydrate with no verified exact external term or CAS, MAPPING_SEMANTICS.md requires preserving the distinct local identity and publishing the nearest external parent asymmetrically with skos:narrowMatch plus the registry exactMatch row. A symmetric closeMatch keeps the row in the kg-microbe synonym-merge path and can still put hydrate aliases onto the anhydrous parent.

Acceptance criteria:
- the four formula-supported sulfate hydrates use ontology_mapping.mapping_quality: NARROW_MATCH
- their CHEBI parent SSSOM rows publish as skos:narrowMatch with the local kgmicrobe.compound exactMatch registry row preserved
- hydrate_review.tsv reports skos:narrowMatch|skos:exactMatch for those rows
- tests pin the asymmetric parent predicate so this does not regress
title: Publish formula-supported local hydrate parents as narrowMatch rows
